ACME ARBITRATION CO. v. ROE CONTRACTORS, INC.
602 U.S. 1 (2020)

JUSTICE LEE delivered the opinion of the Court.
The limitations period for a claim to vacate an award runs from the date the award is delivered.
II
A party who fails to move within that period forfeits the objection.
It is so ordered.

Justice THOMAS, with whom Justice SCALIA joins as to Parts I and II, concurring in part and dissenting in part.
In my view the period should run from the date the party learns of the arbitrator's undisclosed conflict, style B.
